title: Services & packages
subtitle: PPF, tint, polish and paint prices. Kept here, not in Odoo. A change shows on the showroom screen and the website's packages page.
badPrice: Enter an amount in QAR, like 1500 or 1499.50.
noteHint: A short line shown under the name, for example what is included.
pricingHint: This decides the columns of its row and cannot be changed later.
addBody: Its prices start empty. Fill them in the table; customers see it once a price is set.
editBody: The names and the note customers see.
tierBody: The new name is used for every service in this column.
